en_title: Lucia Actress Manni L. Perez Issues First Statement Since GTA 6 Launch
cn_title: Lucia扮演者Manni L. Perez在《GTA 6》发售后首次发声
opus_summary: 《GTA 6》中Lucia的扮演者Manni L. Perez在游戏发售一周后发文，感谢粉丝对游戏和角色的积极反响。她表示自己花了近十年塑造Lucia，并感谢这个角色如今能够成为玩家生活的一小部分。Jason扮演者Dylan Rourke也发文表达了感谢。

paragraphs.en: Manni L. Perez, the actress who plays Lucia in GTA 6 , has issued her first statement since the game came out.
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA 6》中饰演Lucia的演员Manni L. Perez，发表了游戏推出后的首份声明。

paragraphs.en: Perez’s role as Lucia Caminos was confirmed when she was nominated in the Best Performance category for this year’s The Game Awards , a day before GTA 6 launched on November 19. She’s now considered the favorite following the game’s critically acclaimed, record-breaking launch.
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA 6》于11月19日发售的前一天，Perez获得今年The Game Awards最佳表演奖提名，她饰演Lucia Caminos一角的消息也随之得到确认。游戏发售后广获好评并打破纪录，她如今被视为该奖项的热门人选。

paragraphs.en: Now, a week later, Perez took to social media to thank fans for the reception to GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，一周过去了，Perez在社交媒体上感谢粉丝对《GTA 6》的反响。

paragraphs.en: “Life has been such a whirlwind these past couple of days and I just want to take a moment to say thank you,” an Instagram Stories post began.
paragraphs.cn: 她在一则Instagram Stories帖文的开头写道：「过去几天的生活就像一阵旋风，我只想花点时间说声谢谢。」

paragraphs.en: “Thank you to all the new followers, to all the beautiful messages, and the positive reception the game and my character have received.
paragraphs.cn: 「感谢所有新关注我的人，感谢所有美好的留言，也感谢大家对这款游戏和我所饰演角色的积极反响。

paragraphs.en: “I've dedicated almost a decade bringing Lucia to life. She's been such a significant part of mine and I am beyond grateful she now gets to be a small part of yours.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我花了近十年时间赋予Lucia生命。她一直是我生命中非常重要的一部分，而她现在也能成为你们生命中的一小部分，对此我感激不尽。」

paragraphs.en: Perez is an actress with a smattering of credits to her acting resume, including TV guest roles in Jessica Jones, Chicago P.D., and Law & Order: Special Victims Unit. While she hasn't been up to much else over the past few years, it's easy to know why — GTA 6 sounds like it was a pretty involved project. Indeed, Lucia isn’t Perez's first GTA role. In GTA 5, she plays the background character of "Clubber #2," while in GTA Online she voices a blackjack dealer.
paragraphs.cn: Perez是一名演员，演艺履历中有一些作品，包括在电视剧《杰西卡·琼斯》《芝加哥警署》和《法律与秩序：特殊受害者》中客串。虽然她过去几年没有参与太多其他工作，但原因不难理解——《GTA 6》听起来是一个相当费心力的项目。事实上，Lucia并非Perez在《侠盗猎车手》系列中的第一个角色。在《GTA 5》中，她饰演背景角色「夜店顾客2号」；在《GTA Online》中，她则为一名二十一点荷官配音。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Jason actor Dylan Rourke also posted a message of gratitude on Instagram Stories, saying: “Thankful for this wild ride. Gratitude won’t cut it. Make today about the ones you love.”
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，Jason的扮演者Dylan Rourke也在Instagram Stories上发表了一则感谢信息，表示：「感谢这段疯狂的旅程。感激之情难以言表。今天就陪伴你所爱的人吧。」

paragraphs.en: Manni L. Perez shouldn't be confused with Manny Perez, who plays Raul Bautista in GTA 6. This week, Manny Perez bought a PS5 just so he could play the game, saying in a video posted to social media: “Guy, I’m playing and this s**t is crazy! Look how real that looks. I’m learning, I’m loving this, it’s crazy.”
paragraphs.cn: 不要把Manni L. Perez和在《GTA 6》中饰演Raul Bautista的Manny Perez混淆。本周，Manny Perez专门买了一台PS5来玩这款游戏，他在发布到社交媒体上的一段视频中说：「伙计，我正在玩，这他**的太疯狂了！看看这画面有多逼真。我正在学习，我很喜欢这个，太疯狂了。」

paragraphs.en: Other GTA 6 actors who've started to talk about their work on the game include Lexie Shoaibi, who recently spoke out about her "bittersweet" newfound fame after her character, Mandy, went viral online, and Cocoteo FM radio host Issa Lopez, who described the wild non-disclosure agreement she had to sign before working on the game .
paragraphs.cn: 其他开始谈论自己在《GTA 6》中工作的演员还包括Lexie Shoaibi和Cocoteo FM电台主持人Issa Lopez。Shoaibi饰演的角色Mandy在网上走红后，她最近谈到了自己新近获得的「苦乐参半」的名气；Lopez则描述了她在参与游戏制作前必须签署的那份离谱保密协议。

paragraphs.en: Last month, the actors behind GTA 5's Franklin, Michael, and Trevor shared their advice for GTA 6's cast in a bid to ready them for the kind of fame few video game actors achieve.
paragraphs.cn: 上个月，《GTA 5》中Franklin、Michael和Trevor的扮演者向《GTA 6》的演员们分享了建议，希望帮助他们为那种鲜有电子游戏演员能够获得的名气做好准备。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或是不知道接下来该做什么？来IGN查看《GTA 6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧来了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或通过第1章指南与提示、第2章指南与提示以及第3章指南与提示，获取前几章的全部详情。如果你已经开车游遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现和完成的内容，请查看Leonida互动地图。
